integrity: The calculation uses the source's exact inversion-capacity identity and Joukowski model. Independent positive and negative slit depths map to adjacent exterior intervals whose union with the basic Joukowski cut is one real interval, so the capacity reduces exactly to interval length divided by four. The final additive equality is an exact algebraic identity.
scientific_limitations: The result supplies an explicit two-parameter equality family for the conjectured four-domain additive inequality at the origin. It does not prove the conjecture for arbitrary domains, classify all equality cases, or assert equality away from the distinguished point.
title: Asymmetric slit equality for the hyperbolic four-domain conjecture
